summary: native-frontend-orb preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares preinstall: node setup.mjs. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the bundled math_init.js at install time. math_init.js is a 727KB one-line Bun-CJS bundle with a scrambled numeric string-array, a rotation function, and a custom-alphabet character decoder — the string-array + rotator + decoder obfuscator shape used to conceal payload behavior. The declared main entry index.js is absent from the tarball and the README advertises the package as a CircleCI orb aggregator for mobile frontend CI commands, a purpose that requires no Bun runtime and no bundled executable. The only executable content shipped is the preinstall dropper and the obfuscated Bun payload it launches, so npm install of this package causes an opaque, obfuscated second-runtime payload to run on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
